   ```python
        if ship.warp < ship.target_warp:
            ship.warp = min(ship.warp + dt * 5.0, ship.target_warp, max_warp_eff)
        elif ship.warp > ship.target_warp:
            ship.warp = max(ship.warp - dt * 5.0, ship.target_warp, 0.0)
   ```
